statement: Nonfarm business labour productivity growth in 2027 < 2.5% (Bloc A BLS; annual)
status_at_phase_end: Recent run-rate sits right at the threshold: 2025 annual growth 2.3% (revised), 2024 3.2%; 2026 quarterly annualised rates 1.4% (Q1), 2.1% (Q2), 3.6% (Q3 prelim); year-over-year 2.1% in Q3 2026. No AI-driven productivity break visible yet in the series; outcome for 2027 is close to a coin flip on current data. Statement refers to the Bloc A statistics series.

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office: nonfarm business labour productivity rose ~2.3-2.4% for calendar 2025 (Q4 2025 annualised ~1.2%); 2024 revised to ~3.2%.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Q4 2025 preliminary (release date approx. early Feb 2026; may have been delayed). Figures shown are as revised in the 2026-11-05 release; first-print values may differ slightly.

items.summary: Q1 2026 nonfarm business productivity growth was weak, ~1.4% annualised (as later revised), ~2.8% year over year.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs Q1 2026 (preliminary release date approximate); values from revised table of 2026-11-05.

items.summary: Q2 2026 preliminary: nonfarm business productivity +1.4% annualised; unit labour costs +1.3%; productivity +1.4% over four quarters per first print. Later revised to +2.1%.
items.detail: BLS 'Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2026, Preliminary' (2026-08-06).

items.summary: Q3 2026 preliminary: nonfarm business productivity +3.6% annualised (output +3.7%, hours +0.1%), +2.1% year over year; Q2 revised to +2.1%. Typical revision band for the first print is -1.1 to +1.4 pp.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs Q3 2026 preliminary, Table 2 (2026-11-05); index 121.9 (2017=100).
